Term1: ORZID2 GMENU SEPSIS SUSPECTED SKIN SOFT TISSUE
Text:
## SEPSIS WITH SUSPECTED SKIN AND SOFT TISSUE INFECTION
Consider consulting Infectious Diseases if skin and soft tissue infection is not
strongly suspected as the main source of infection.
## Aggressive surgical debridement is recommended
## For [necrotizing infections](orzc-gmenu-necrotizing-infections), refer to those recommendations for treatment
Necrotizing infections
## Non-purulent infection
[Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h](psjizid-cefazolin-2gm-ivpb-q8h-sepsis)
## Purulent infection, recent MRSA isolate, or alternative to above
[Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h](orz-set-abx-vanco-sepsis-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)
## Septic shock
[Piperacillin/Tazobactam 4.5 gm IV Q6H <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h](orz-set-abx-sepsis-pip-tazo-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro-vanco)
< OR >
[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h](orz-set-abx-sepsis-cefepime-2gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)
## Severe beta-lactam reaction
[Treatment of Sepsis with Severe Beta-Lactam Reaction](orzc-gmenu-sepsis-severe-beta-lactam-reaction)
## Consider selecting alternative agents from separate drug class if recently
## treated with any of the above antibiotics.

## ER

Guidance
## Non-purulent infection
Cefazolin 2 gm IV once STAT
## Purulent infection, recent MRSA isolate, or alternative to above
Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV once STAT
## Septic shock
Piperacillin/Tazobactam 4.5 gm IV once STAT <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV
once STAT
Cefepime 2 gm IV once STAT <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV once STAT
